verdict.rationale: Fin Voice is a documented, deployable phone channel. It is grounded in the knowledge base and applies the business's policies on every call, running on a latency-optimized model built for voice. However, no evidence shows that Procedures or actions on external systems run on calls the same way they do in chat. The speech-in/speech-out mechanics are also only implied by the 'Voice' product, not described. Missing for 10: documented parity of actions/Procedures between voice and chat, explicit speech recognition/synthesis details, independent or hands-on corroboration of call handling.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent handles phone calls — speech in, speech out — with the same knowledge and actions as chat
